headline: Amended development agreement for Abbott Court redevelopment with LMG approved, letting town administrator sign.
summary: The town administrator said the changes are mostly editorial. They set timing for parking and the phase 1 residential space count, split the closing dates for phase 1 and phase 2, and drop a requirement that the town seek a first-floor commercial tenant. Separately, $128,000 was approved for an engineering study to extend the Derry Rail Trail to the Londonderry town line. Derry's share is $25,600 from Gateway TIF funds, and the federal program reimburses 80% of approved costs.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, 5-0, including unanticipated Primex revenue and a Conservation Commission alternate's resignation.
Approved $128,000 from Gateway TIF funds for the Derry Rail Trail engineering study, 5-0.
Approved an amendment to the Abbott Court Master Development Agreement with LMG NH LLC, letting the town administrator sign, 5-0.
discussion: Abbott Court development agreement: The town administrator said staff and LMG hold weekly calls and that the changes are mostly editorial. No questions were raised before the vote.

Derry Rail Trail engineering: The public works director said the town has about 3.5 miles of paved trail. The first phase is an engineering study to about 30% design, and final engineering and construction will come to the council later.
Election results and recount: Tina Guilford reported 12,677 voters, a record for a midterm, and a recount that kept the results the same.
First-quarter budget report: The chief financial officer said general fund revenues were 26% of budget and expenses were 33% as of September 30th, 2026.
Public forum thanks: Residents thanked the election workers and town staff, and one wished everyone a happy Thanksgiving.

Madam Chair, seeing no questions, I move resolution number 2026-061 to approve a supplemental appropriation in the Gateway T Gateway Tax Increment Financing District fund... And Chair votes yes. Motion passes 5-0.

Seeing as no questions, Madam Chair, I move Resolution Number 2026-063 to authorize an amendment to the Master Development Agreement with LMG NH LLC for the redevelopment of Abbott Court... And Chair votes yes. Motion passes 5-0.
